title: 第4章 云宫掠天术
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
夜弦月连番试探后离开了。

    秦然躺在床上闭着眼睛装晕，心中却是长长的松了口气。

    他还没死，说明赌对了！

    夜弦月生性多疑，多次试探倒也符合她的人设，毕竟此事牵扯到了她心中最敏感、最脆弱的那个点。

    有了今日之事，夜弦月那边的敌意就算不能全消，起码也会大大降低。

    “这个开局还算不错，接下来得趁热打铁，继续刺激夜弦月最敏感的点，争取早点打消她的敌意，或许有机会给她争取过来。”

    “每日奖励凌晨结算，算算时间，应该差不多了……”

    【叮咚！】

    【今日生存挑战结束！】

    【完成度评估中……】

    【您成功避开毒酒危机、您成功避免龙运剥夺、您成功躲过夜弦月两次试探……您额外获得夜弦月高额好感度。】

    【您超额完成挑战任务！】

    【最终评估，首次任务完成度200%】

    【触发超级奖励！】

    【叮咚！已为您量身匹配超级新手礼包×2！】

    秦然兴奋的睁开眼睛。

    手中凭空出现了两件物品。

    一本绘制着云纹的精美书籍，以及一个被土黄色气流包裹的瓷瓶。

    《云宫掠天术（完整篇）》

    品阶：帝阶法决

    介绍：在灵魂中铸造一座无上魂宫

    1.魂宫可随心意屏蔽自身气息，隔绝一切精神类攻击及探查

    2.被攻击命中后，可将敌人术法掠夺至魂宫中步步拆解，最终化为原始篇为己用。

    说明：帝族云家的镇族绝学，位列玄黄大陆三十六帝诀之一

    “卧槽！新手礼包开出王炸？？”

    秦然目瞪口呆。

    在《假太监》的设定中，功法武技以及神兵利器可分为黄阶、玄阶、地阶、天阶，以及至高的帝阶。

    所有帝诀皆出自诞生过大帝的无上家族，云家便是传承万载的帝族之一。

    曾经的云家，一度被强者们看作是最无赖的对手，与云家强者对战都得收敛着来。

    原因便是帝诀《云宫掠天术》。

    毕竟，没有哪个人想打打架，自家绝学被偷了去。

    遗憾的是，从数千年前开始，完整的《云宫掠天术》便失传了。
content_en:
Ye Xianyue left after repeated tests.

Qin Ran lay on the bed and pretended to be dizzy with his eyes closed, but he let out a long sigh of relief.

He's not dead yet, which means the bet was right!

Ye Xianyue is suspicious by nature, and the repeated testing is in line with her personality. After all, this matter involves the most sensitive and vulnerable point in her heart.

With what happened today, even if the hostility on Ye Xianyue's side cannot be completely eliminated, at least it will be greatly reduced.

"This is a pretty good start. Next, we have to strike while the iron is hot and continue to stimulate Ye Xianyue's most sensitive points, trying to get rid of her hostility as soon as possible. Maybe there will be a chance to win her over."

"The daily rewards will be settled in the early morning. Calculate the time, it should be almost..."

[Ding dong!】

【Today’s survival challenge ends!】

[Completeness evaluation in progress...]

[You successfully avoided the poisonous wine crisis, you successfully avoided the deprivation of Dragon Luck, you successfully avoided the two temptations of the Night Crescent Moon... You additionally gained a high amount of favorability from the Night Crescent Moon.】

[You have exceeded the challenge task!】

[Final evaluation, first task completion 200%]

【Trigger super reward!】

[Ding dong!The Super Novice Gift Pack x 2 has been matched just for you!】

Kieran opened his eyes excitedly.

Two items appeared out of thin air in his hand.

A beautifully painted book with cloud patterns, and a porcelain bottle wrapped in earth-yellow airflow.

"Yun Gong Tian Lu Technique (Complete)"

Grade: Imperial Level Magical Judgment

Introduction: Forge a Supreme Soul Palace in the Soul

1. The soul palace can shield one's own breath at will, isolating all mental attacks and explorations

2. After being hit by an attack, you can plunder the enemy's spells to the Soul Palace and dismantle them step by step, and finally turn them into the original chapter for your own use.

Explanation: The imperial family's secret art of suppressing the clan, the Yun family, is one of the thirty-six emperor's arts in Xuanhuang Continent.

"Damn it! The novice gift pack contains a king bomb??"

Kieran was stunned.

In the setting of "False Eunuch", the martial arts, martial arts and magical weapons can be divided into yellow level, Xuan level, earth level, heaven level, and the highest emperor level.

All emperor techniques come from the supreme family that gave birth to the great emperor. The Yun family is one of the imperial families that has been passed down for thousands of years.

The Yun family was once regarded as the most rogue opponent by the strong men, and they had to restrain themselves when fighting against the strong Yun family.

The reason is the Emperor's Technique "Yun Gong Tian Lu Technique".

After all, no one wants to get into a fight and have his or her secret skills stolen.

Regrettably, the complete "Yungong Heaven Sweeping Technique" has been lost since thousands of years ago.
